combat_probabilities.source: PACKET_UNIT_ACTIONS after an explicit PACKET_UNIT_GET_ACTIONS background-refresh request
combat_probabilities.scope: adjacent packet-visible foreign-unit tiles reachable by a current server-advertised combat action
combat_probabilities.selected_defender: target_unit_id selected by the native Freeciv action subsystem

fail_closed: actor owner, type, tile, moves, HP, veteran, activity, and transport revision must still match
the complete packet-visible target stack revision must still match
malformed probability intervals and protocol sentinels are rejected
timed-out requests are removed and cannot complete a later projection

policy_boundary.proxy: projects native player-visible action probability intervals and selected defender without reconstructing combat mechanics
policy_boundary.planner: preserves interval width as residual unknown mass and keeps multi-unit combat operations shadow-only
policy_boundary.authority: no combat operation may execute from this transport capability alone

invariants: the query is opt-in and bounded to 32 actor-target pairs
no hidden tile, unit, route, or opponent action is requested
current legal action membership remains independently required
joint multi-step probability is never formed by multiplying unconditional current-state action probabilities
